title: GUVI: Simple Interest Calculator
description: Given Principal `p`, Time in years `t`, and Annual Interest Rate percentage `r`, compute Simple Interest = (P * T * R) / 100 rounded to 2 decimal places.
starter_code:
def simple_interest(p: float, t: float, r: float) -> float:
    pass
solution:
def simple_interest(p: float, t: float, r: float) -> float:
    return round((p * t * r) / 100.0, 2)
explanation: Standard financial interest formula evaluated in O(1) time.
